newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rate ends a shade up at 20.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rate ends a shade up at 20.5 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rate ended slightly up at 20.5 percent on Wednesday in a quiet, but relatively liquid market, traders said.
Overnight rates traded between 20.25 and 20.5 percent for most of the session. Tuesday rates closed at 20.25 percent.
"There's plenty of liquidity and the market's very quiet," said Erika Kaiser of Unicbank, adding that one reason for the lack of activity was that rates were still below central bank repo rates.
The National Bank of Hungary's one-week reverse repo rate currently stands at 21.00 percent.
